# Late evidence only

`tree/` preserves the completed S1, S2, and Layer workshop returns that were
not committed at the Foldlab pin. These bytes are not part of the pinned
snapshot, carry no Git-blob claim, and must never be imported by Effect4.

Their closed source-path and SHA-256 inventory is
`../LATE-MANIFEST.tsv`. Promotion of any finding requires a separate native
Effect4 contract, implementation, and proof graph.
